A huge fortune on paper is not the same as cash in hand.

Kevin explains that today's biggest names hold their wealth in stock, and selling it would crash the price. So they have a lot of money on paper, but not that much in cash.

Carnegie was different. He sold his steel business for cash, then spent almost all of it building libraries across America.

Kevin says that is why Carnegie wanted to teach people about success.

Which would you rather have: a big fortune on paper or cash in hand?
